prompt:
小红书信息图。整体采用“顶部超大标题＋中部大型结构主视觉＋下部图鉴式分类单元”的纵向结构。顶部设置一行醒目的大标题，字号明显大于其他文字，横向展开，占据独立标题区，并与下方内容保持清晰间距。画面中部放置一个尺寸很大的完整主视觉，占据画面主要宽度，作为整张卡片的核心；主视觉内部可根据自身结构划分若干区域，并直接嵌入简短标签，使文字与主视觉形成一体化标注，不拆成多个独立卡片。画面下部排列多个尺寸较小的独立视觉单元，采用规则但不过分拥挤的多列布局，每个单元由“小视觉＋下方短标签”组成，尺寸尽量统一，横向和纵向间距稳定，形成图鉴、目录或分类展示的扫描节奏。小单元数量可以较多，但必须明显小于中部主视觉，不使用复杂卡片框，依靠留白、对齐和重复结构建立秩序。整体阅读顺序为顶部标题→中部整体结构→下部细分类单元，避免左右分栏、复杂装饰和不规则拼贴。

本次输入：【填写标题、核对过的要点、顺序或关系】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
Xiaohongshu infographic. Use a vertical structure of “oversized headline at the top + large structural hero visual in the middle + catalog-like classification units at the bottom.” Place one prominent headline across a dedicated top title area, clearly larger than all other text, with clear spacing before the content below. Place one large, complete hero visual across most of the middle area as the core of the card; the hero visual may contain several internal regions and short labels embedded directly within it, integrating text with the visual instead of adding external callouts. Arrange multiple smaller independent visual units below in a regular but breathable multi-column layout. Each unit consists of a small visual with a short label underneath; keep sizes consistent and horizontal and vertical spacing stable to create the scanning rhythm of an atlas, directory, or category display. The smaller units may be numerous but must remain clearly subordinate to the central hero visual. Avoid complex card frames and establish order through whitespace, alignment, and repeated structure. The reading order is top headline → central whole structure → lower detailed categories; avoid side-by-side columns, excessive decoration, and irregular collage.

Inputs: [Provide title, verified points, and their order or relationships].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
